integrity: Original calculations and proof text are supplied; numerical tests are supporting evidence, not proofs for infinite assertions. Research claim independently audited: no.
scientific_limitations: Only maximal open two-cell strict-alternating islands and their union areas; no claim of the global periodic fraction, boundary dynamics, other islands, or total regular area. The full general disk/polygon phenomenon and three special rational cases are pre-existing. Unindexed equivalent area results remain a priority risk.
title: The exact alternating-island area law for symmetric half-plane rotations
